violations.text: Egg bites packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, the business name/address, and the major allergens. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026

The following was observed of non-food contact surfaces: 1) The fan above the reach-in units were observed with an accumulation of dust 2) The dairy/coffee reach-in cooler was observed with milk residue on the shelves 3) The ice machine was observed with pink and black residue The non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned as often as necessary to prevent the possible contamination of food. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
